name: Read the vessel inspector at the C-Lion1 cut and after the anchor is raised
description: Validates Ship mode's vessel inspector on Yi Peng 3: the side profile with the anchor dragging and 316 m of chain to scale at 02:00 UTC, the figures derived at that moment, and the anchor stowed once the drag window has ended.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/yi-peng-3-2024?t=2024-11-18T02:00Z&mode=ship and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the ship card (data-testid ship-card) shows "Yi Peng 3" and "Bulk carrier, 224 m, China. IMO 9224984", and the inspector inside it (data-testid vessel-inspector) has data-state "dragging"

Assert the side profile (data-testid vessel-profile) has data-state "dragging", data-chain-out-metres "316" and data-layback-metres "302", and its text includes "chain out 316 m", "anchor, 302 m behind the hawse" and "47 m"
Assert the anchor status (data-testid vessel-anchor-state) reads "Anchor dragging" with data-state "dragging", and the line above the figures reads "At 02:00 UTC" followed by "derived"

Assert the figures read Speed "5.6" kn (data-testid vessel-number-speed), Course "233" (data-testid vessel-number-course) and C-Lion1 "18" m (data-testid vessel-number-nearest-line), each with data-state "interpolated", and the text says "never a recorded speed"
Assert Chain out (data-testid vessel-chain-out) reads "316 m, 84 mm, all of one anchor" and the Anchor row reads "8.7 t, IACS UR A1 for this size"
Navigate to /cases/yi-peng-3-2024?t=2024-11-18T10:00Z&mode=ship and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"

Assert the anchor status (data-testid vessel-anchor-state) reads "Anchor stowed", the side profile (data-testid vessel-profile) has data-state "stowed", Chain out (data-testid vessel-chain-out) reads "None, the anchor is stowed", and the line above the figures reads "At 10:00 UTC" followed by "from AIS"
